ui.chat.run_details.jobs.role: section label of the run panel's background-jobs list
ui.chat.run_details.jobs.tone: noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.run_details.jobs.note: Labels the panel section that lists running shell and eval jobs. The composer's jobs chip counts the same rows, so this word is the list's only name and must match how that chip speaks of them.

ui.chat.run_details.keep.role: safe-choice button in the background-job cancel confirmation
ui.chat.run_details.keep.tone: single verb, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.run_details.keep.note: Closes the confirmation without cancelling the job, leaving it running. It takes the card's opening focus, so it must read as the safe choice beside Cancel.

ui.chat.run_details.pane_label: Accessible name of the run-details pane element.
ui.chat.run_details.title: Heading of the run-details pane and the crumb back to it.
ui.chat.run_details.subagent_path_label: Accessible name of the breadcrumb navigation through subagent readers.
ui.chat.run_details.previous_subagent: Tooltip and accessible name of the control that opens the previous subagent.
ui.chat.run_details.next_subagent: Tooltip and accessible name of the control that opens the next subagent.
ui.chat.run_details.close_label: Tooltip and accessible name of the control that closes the run-details pane.
ui.chat.run_details.children_unopenable: Notice shown when the backend cannot open a subagent transcript.
ui.chat.run_details.updating_backend: Button label while the backend update is running.
ui.chat.run_details.update_backend: Button that starts the backend update from the run-details pane.
ui.chat.run_details.retry: Button that re-queries backend capabilities after a failed open.
ui.chat.run_details.unopenable: Sentence shown when a subagent transcript could not be opened.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.title: Dialog title when no conversation is open to sign in from.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.title_for_s: Dialog title naming the MCP server being signed in to. {server} is a product/server name, kept as the backend supplies it.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.close: Button that dismisses the MCP sign-in dialog.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.no_session: Explanation shown when no session is open, so sign-in is unavailable.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.replace_gra: Primary action re-authorising a server that already has a grant.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.continue_in: Primary action starting an OAuth sign-in in the browser.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.try_again: Secondary action that re-runs the sign-in probe after a failure.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.cancel_sign: Secondary action that cancels the sign-in operation in flight.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.checking: Progress sentence while the sign-in method is being probed.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.grant_body: Sentence explaining that a browser window will open for approval.
ui.chat.run_details.mcp_auth.replaces_gr: Appended sentence when re-authorising an existing grant.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.error_shorten: Note under a truncated error payload explaining why the text stops.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.delegated_wit: Section label naming the tools/capabilities a subagent was delegated with.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.read_only_foo: Footer stating that a subagent's transcript cannot be used to steer it.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.no_session_id: Empty state: the subagent has no session id to open.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.no_transcript: Empty state: the subagent's transcript file does not exist yet.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.directory_gon: Empty state: the subagent's session directory is missing.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.loading_conve: Placeholder while the subagent transcript is loading.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.no_conversati: Empty state: the subagent transcript holds no conversation.
ui.chat.run_details.reader.failed: Label above the subagent's own error text.
